THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
WINTER
049
STUDY 094
Gray Turtleneck Dress & Tan Boots
Rights check
Source: 24973.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black hair
flowing slightly to one side stands in a full-length pose
against a pale studio backdrop. She wears a fitted
heathered gray ribbed turtleneck mini dress with long
sleeves, cinched at the waist with a thin brown leather
belt. Tall tan suede knee-high boots with buckle detail
and a pointed toe complete the look. Her expression is
calm and direct. Soft, even studio light with a glossy
floor. Palette of heathered gray, chocolate, and tan.
Clean and cozy, in the style of a minimalist winter
lookbook.
Clean, cozy, sleek
WORKING NOTES
- The ribbed knit and tan boots create the warm-neutral
contrast.
- Add 'full-length' to keep the boots in frame.
Try this: Use full-length framing to include the boots.
